MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The capacitor assortment complements my breadboards, PCB boards, and circuit components, giving me parts I can use together in electronics projects.",
    "The adjustable power supply fits the same circuit-building interest because it would help me power and test breadboard and relay projects."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The heavy-wire connector serves a different scale of electrical work from my small circuits; being electrical does not make it useful to me.",
    "The abrasives, sealing kit, anchors, and leather glue require projects I have not indicated. My caster purchase also does not establish a need for a particular washer size.",
    "The thermal camera connects to my thermometer purchase, but that connection alone does not give me a current use for it or establish compatibility with my phone."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been interpreted as broad interest in workshop and repair supplies, although I choose supplies for specific tasks.",
    "A single purchase seems to invite related accessories without enough evidence that I own the necessary equipment or need those accessories."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of breadboards, PCB supplies, a relay, and a battery holder provide a stronger reason to suggest complementary circuit-building supplies.",
    "Exact fit matters to me: electrical scale, hardware dimensions, device compatibility, and quantity determine whether something is useful.",
    "Several electronics purchases were years before my latest caster purchase, so they suggest an interest without proving that a particular project is active now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my circuit-building interest but stretch it into repair and workshop needs that my history does not establish."
}
